analyst.summary: Wakefit is a well-known D2C sleep and home-furnishings brand that recently listed, and it is still prioritizing growth over profitability -- revenue continues to expand at a healthy pace, but the company is currently loss-making on trailing returns, and foreign institutional holding has declined noticeably since listing. We maintain a Sell: it is early days as a public company, competition in the category is intense, and profitability has not yet been demonstrated.
